login.welcome: Welcome! Your exciting journey into the realm of Vision AI Platform starts right here. Let reCamera redefine your vision of possibilities.
login.agreeSuffix: . By checking the box, users understand reCamera operates solely on local networks and commit to maintaining enterprise-grade network security for all vision AI operations.
login.oldPasswordExtraPrefix: For first time login, default password is
login.newPasswordExtra: Password must be 8-32 characters and include letters, numbers, and symbols
login.passwordMismatch: The new password that you entered do not match!

agreement.intro: Welcome to reCamera Vision AI System. To ensure secure operation of your AI-powered camera, please review and confirm:
agreement.localIntro: This vision AI camera functions exclusively within local networks. You agree:
agreement.local1: Not to configure external/remote access capabilities
agreement.local2: To maintain all connections within your private network environment
agreement.local3: To disable UPnP/WAN exposure features if present
agreement.netIntro: By proceeding, you confirm that your network:
agreement.net4: Uses strong unique credentials (recommended 12+ character password)
agreement.dataIntro: As a vision AI camera, reCamera:
agreement.data1: Processes video data locally unless otherwise specified
agreement.data3: Excludes cloud connectivity by default design
agreement.respIntro: You acknowledge that Seeed Studio is not liable for:
agreement.resp1: Security incidents from unsecured network environments
agreement.resp3: Performance issues when used beyond local network parameters

loading.waiting: Please wait for node-red service to get start, it takes around 1 and an half minutes.
loading.errorBefore: Looks like something went wrong with system. Please check system and restart, or contact

apps.title: Applications
apps.subtitle: Each application is a complete scene solution. Only one application can hold the camera at a time.
apps.loadError: Could not load the application list. The appMgr service may be unavailable on this firmware.
apps.noAppsHint: Install a solution package (.deb) to register applications here.
apps.activateContent: Switching applications will stop the currently running application and interrupt its RTSP/MQTT output. The camera will be handed over to the new application.
apps.stopContent: The application and its streams will be stopped. You can activate it again at any time.

live.title: Live Debug
live.noActiveHint: Activate an application to view and debug its output.
live.debugStreamHint: Taps H.264 from the device only while enabled — zero overhead when off.
live.resultOverlayHint: Draw inference boxes over the video.
live.pipelineHint: This application runs a fixed multi-model pipeline — its components cannot be switched.
live.noMessages: No messages received yet — waiting for inference results.
live.enableDebugHint: Enable the debug stream to see live inference results here.
live.debugOffHint: Debug stream is off. Toggle it on to preview the camera in the browser.
live.fallbackDebugUnavailable: The debug stream is unavailable right now. You can still open the application's RTSP stream directly:
live.fallbackNoDebug: This application does not provide a browser debug stream. Open its RTSP stream with a player such as VLC:
live.fallbackNoRtsp: No RTSP address declared by this application.
live.vlcHint: VLC: Media → Open Network Stream → paste the address above.
live.switchModelContent: The application will restart to load the new model. Streams will be briefly interrupted.
live.modelUpdated: Model updated. The application is restarting with the new model.

device.title: Device
device.subtitle: Low-level device controls and health.
device.ledUnavailableMsg: LED "{{name}}" is not available on this device
device.noBattery: No battery detected on this device.
device.sensorUnavailable: Sensor endpoint unavailable on this firmware.
device.timezoneNotApplied: Time set, but timezone "{{tz}}" was not accepted by the device
device.ntpFailed: NTP sync failed — the device needs internet access
device.timeHint: "Sync from browser" copies this browser's clock and timezone to the device — works offline. NTP requires internet on the device.
device.powerHint: Both actions interrupt all running applications.
device.rebootContent: The device will restart. All running applications and streams will be interrupted.
device.shutdownContent: The device will power off. You will need physical access to turn it back on.

audio.speaker: Speaker
audio.playConfirm: Test sound played — confirm you can hear it at the device
audio.busy: Audio device is busy — another operation is in progress
audio.micHint: Records from the on-board microphone (16 kHz mono) and plays it back in this browser. The test sound comes out of the device speaker.

config.title: Configuration
config.saveContent: The new configuration will be saved to the device. If the application is running it will restart, briefly interrupting its streams.
config.savedRestarting: Configuration saved — the application is restarting.
config.busy: Another app operation is in progress — try again in a moment
config.zoneHint: Click to add vertices (max {{max}}), drag a vertex to move it. Double-click or press Done to finish.
config.lineHint: Click twice to place endpoints A and B, drag to adjust. The arrow marks the "in" direction.
config.gridHint: Debug stream is off — drawing on a blind grid. Enable the debug stream to calibrate on the live view.
